text: In the moment of victory, Tuppence betrayed a somewhat unsportsmanlike triumph. “Now who’s on top and who’s underneath?” she crowed. The other’s face was convulsed with rage. For a minute Tuppence thought she was going to spring upon her, which would have placed the girl in an unpleasant dilemma, since she meant to draw the line at actually letting off the revolver. However, with an effort Mrs. Vandemeyer controlled herself, and at last a slow evil smile crept over her face.
